title: Site Quality / Completeness Re-Check
methodology: Reuses AQ-02B and AQ-05's existing certification machinery (scripts/verify-google-crawlability.mjs, scripts/verify-google-indexability.mjs) rather than inventing new quality requirements, re-run fresh after all of this initiative's regeneration to confirm nothing regressed.

broken_pages_links.evidence: 0 orphans, 0 broken links encountered in the reachability crawl (re-run after all AQ-07/AQ-06R2 regeneration).

placeholder_text_template_variables.evidence: 0 matches for lorem ipsum / coming soon / under construction / TODO: across every published HTML file, checked fresh this pass.

empty_sections.evidence: Unaffected by this initiative — AQ-02A's empty-section guarantee (0/1,252) was never touched.

duplicate_pages.evidence: 1,038/1,038 canonical URLs self-consistent and globally unique, 1,038/1,038 titles unique, 1,038/1,038 descriptions unique — all re-verified fresh.

accidental_unpublished_domain_exposure.evidence: 0 cheese references in sitemap.xml or sitemaps/site-pages.xml. 0 links to any /cheeses/, /cheese-groups/, or /cheese-categories/ path found anywhere in the live navigation or hub pages. cheese-groups/, cheese-categories/, cheeses/ remain untracked in git — confirmed via git status, unchanged throughout this entire initiative including the large-scale template regeneration in AQ-06R2-FIX.

redirects.evidence: 0 chains, 0 loops across 51 rules, re-verified fresh after all regeneration.

canonical_urls.evidence: All self-referential and globally unique, re-verified fresh.

sitemap_coverage.evidence: 0 missing, 0 stale entries across all published domains, re-verified fresh after AQ-06R2-FIX's sitemap regeneration.

navigation.evidence: Unaffected structurally by this initiative (only label/heading text changed, not link structure) — reachability crawl confirms full navigability.

unfinished_visible_sections.evidence: No unfinished-looking sections found in this pass's direct reading (reviewer simulation, AQ-06R3) or in the mechanical placeholder-text scan.

ad_placement_readiness.evidence: 0 adsbygoogle/data-ad-client markup found anywhere — confirmed still a clean, ad-free slate.
ad_placement_readiness.content_to_ad_balance: Improved since AQ-06D: the previously-templated, thinner-content domains (legume, nut-seed, sweet-flavor, sauce-condiment) now carry genuinely substantive, specific prose per entity (AQ-07C), strengthening the content-to-future-ad ratio on exactly the pages AQ-06D flagged as having the least headroom.
ad_placement_readiness.mobile_layout: Same 8 media-query breakpoints and correct viewport meta tag confirmed present, unchanged from AQ-06D. Not independently measured via device testing — same disclosed limitation as AQ-06D, not newly assumed clean.
ad_placement_readiness.would_ads_make_the_site_appear_primarily: No — the site currently has 0 ads and a content-first structure (narrative before data tables, per AQ-02A's architecture) that would remain the dominant visual experience even with standard ad placements added.

policy_vs_recommendation.policy_requirement_unmet: None — the 2 pre-monetization items (cookie-consent mechanism, ads.txt) are not current violations, they are prerequisites correctly sequenced before, not during, ad enablement, same as AQ-06D's framing.
policy_vs_recommendation.recommendation: Same 2 items carried forward unchanged: build a cookie-consent mechanism before enabling personalized ads; add ads.txt once a publisher ID exists.

overall_certification: PASS — no new site-quality or ad-placement-readiness issues found; all AQ-06D findings re-confirmed unchanged, all AQ-02B/AQ-05 certifications re-run fresh and clean.
